title: CONVERGENCE donor license ledger
method: Evidence taken from cloned repository files at the exact commit listed. README badges and package metadata were treated as claims, not proof, and were verified against LICENSE files on disk.

classificationScale.CLEAR: Permissive license text present at audited commit; commercial closed-source mobile distribution compatible.
classificationScale.CONDITIONAL: Usable but requires a specific action (attribution file, NOTICE, version pin, subset restriction).
classificationScale.DO_NOT_COPY: No valid grant found, or a restriction incompatible with commercial distribution. Design reference only.
